The '''MDF motivator''' was a model of [[Motivator/Legends|motivator]]<ref name="NEGTD" /> meant to be installed in [[Interrogation droid/Legends|torture droids]].<ref name="SGTD">''[[Scavenger's Guide to Droids]]''</ref> [[MerenData/Legends|MerenData]] used them in the production of illegal [[Droid/Legends|droids]] for the [[House of Tagge/Legends|House of Tagge]].<ref name="NEGTD" /> An employee at MerenData accidentally substituted a case of MDF motivators for a case of [[EV motivator]]s during the construction of the [[EV-series supervisor droid/Legends|EV-series supervisor droid]]. The result was a large number of EV-series [[Supervisor droid/Legends|supervisor droids]] being released to the market with ruthless, vicious, and psychotic temperaments.<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
